notes: The San Francisco Planning Commission's minutes of its meetings of January - June 1997, from volume 43 of the San Francisco Public Library's deposit at the Internet Archive (43minutesofsanfran1997san, labelled Jan-June 1997). Action minutes, as in 1994-1996: each calendar item prints its case number and planner, the property with its assessor's block and lot, the request, the speakers by name, and the action with the vote and the motion or resolution number (from 24 April the Commission numbers its conditional-use actions as resolutions). The wireless-antenna applications again carry a staff statement of the building's height and use (a medical office building, a church steeple, the Kabuki Theater, a law library, a fire station's hose tower, the Marshall Hale hospital, Lick Wilmerding High School, the Sailors' Union of the Pacific). Pages were split from the hOCR search text on the Internet Archive page index (first two fields are the text offsets), counting the viewer page among the leaves scandata.xml does not mark addToAccessFormats=false, and every page is dated from the meeting header it sits under. Three kinds of finding: what the Commission decided about a property, dated to the meeting that decided it; what the calendar states stood on or occupied the property; and one landmark-district action. A continuance, a withdrawal, a motion of intent, a failed motion, an item under 'Items to be continued' or an informational report is not a decision. Every raw.text span was matched mechanically (whitespace-flexible, per ' ... ' segment) against the one page it cites. The minutes name applicants, owners, architects, neighbours, objectors, commissioners and staff in every item; none of them is in any field. Companies, institutions, businesses and named buildings are kept.

coverage.remaining: Every page of volume 43 (43minutesofsanfran1997san, Jan-June 1997) was read: 24 regular meetings, 9 January to 26 June 1997, with their addenda, and the special joint hearings with the Redevelopment Agency Commission (23 January, 10 and 17 April, 8 May, 26 June), the Small Business Advisory Commission (27 February) and the Recreation and Park Commission (1 May). No meeting is minuted for 2 or 30 January or 29 May. Next: volume 44 (44minutesofsanfran1997san, July-Dec 1997), then volumes 45-58 (1998-2005).
coverage.note: 201 OCR pages with text out of 400 viewer pages (402 scanned leaves; the empty ones are blank versos, the library cards and the digitization notice), read in one session by a single reader with no sub-agents. 128 findings: 121 decisions, 6 statements of what stood on or occupied a property, 1 landmark-district action. The half-year of the Sprint Spectrum and Pacific Bell antenna sites, of the Bernal Dwellings and Yerba Buena Plaza East demolitions, of the live/work fight in the South of Market and Potrero Hill, of the conversion of 801 Market to a hotel, of the Old Main Library Annex demolished for the Asian Art Museum, and of the Giants ballpark EIR certified on 26 June.
